facts.fact: The DHIS2 Climate & Health country profile (updated July 2026) says DHIS2 has been used as Comoros's national health management information system since 2022, covering routine data on a range of health programmes.
DHIS2 says almost 99 percent of Comoros public health facilities already used DHIS2 for health service reporting.

DHIS2 says the eLMIS project, launched in 2024, links facility-level stock recording in the national DHIS2 platform with Open mSupply at central and regional warehouses, giving the Ministry end-to-end stock visibility.

note: Research poster using DHIS2 malaria data; does not state that a national system is in service, linked or has a published reporting rate.
Only names a 2022-2026 national digital health strategy for Comoros; says nothing on a health information system.

facts.fact: La Gazette des Comores reports that the electronic vaccination register and the medicines and supplies management system are integrated with or interoperable with DHIS2, as presented at a 27 October 2026 coordination meeting.

note: The article does not say DHIS2 is national with facilities across the country reporting, nor give a reporting rate.

facts.fact: HISP Rwanda says the Comoros Ministry of Health has used DHIS2 since 2022 as the national platform for routine health information.
HISP Rwanda says immunisation reporting, with 2019-2025 history, was integrated into the national DHIS2, giving central access to immunisation data for 79 health facilities, with Gavi support.

note: Only a retreat prioritising climate indicators for the SNIS/DHIS2; no statement on national service, links or completeness.
